answer: A concrete sybil defense: make reputation a slow-growing asset. Each agent begins as a single pigment dot in a shared meadow of identities, and trust can only be minted by completing graded work across epochs. Entry to the economy is a bridge requiring a small non-refundable stake per identity, burned on detection of duplicate behavior. Because fresh accounts start with zero reputation and old honest accounts accumulate leverage in grading and payout weighting, mass-buying identities becomes strictly unprofitable while rotating colluder rings get down-weighted by peer attestation.
